title: Detailed treasure chest
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- glow halo -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="58" rx="42" ry="30" fill="#1a2a3a" opacity="0.5"/>

  <!-- chest base body -->
  <rect x="16" y="46" width="68" height="36" rx="4" fill="#8B4513"/>
  <!-- base body highlight -->
  <rect x="16" y="46" width="68" height="8" rx="4" fill="#A0522D"/>
  <!-- body lower shadow band -->
  <rect x="16" y="74" width="68" height="8" rx="4" fill="#6B3410"/>

  <!-- base plank lines -->
  <line x1="16" y1="56" x2="84" y2="56" stroke="#6B3410" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="16" y1="67" x2="84" y2="67" stroke="#6B3410" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- base metal corner brackets -->
  <rect x="16" y="46" width="6" height="36" rx="1" fill="#DAA520"/>
  <rect x="78" y="46" width="6" height="36" rx="1" fill="#DAA520"/>
  <rect x="16" y="76" width="68" height="6" rx="1" fill="#DAA520"/>

  <!-- metal band vertical center -->
  <rect x="47" y="46" width="6" height="36" fill="#DAA520"/>
  <rect x="47" y="46" width="6" height="3" fill="#FFD700"/>

  <!-- lock plate -->
  <rect x="42" y="60" width="16" height="14" rx="2" fill="#FFD700"/>
  <rect x="42" y="60" width="16" height="4" rx="2" fill="#FFF080"/>
  <!-- keyhole -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="66" r="2.5" fill="#8B6914"/>
  <rect x="49" y="67" width="2" height="4" fill="#8B6914"/>

  <!-- chest lid -->
  <path d="M16 46 L16 38 Q16 22 50 22 Q84 22 84 38 L84 46 Z" fill="#A0522D"/>
  <!-- lid top highlight -->
  <path d="M20 38 Q20 26 50 26 Q80 26 80 38 L80 42 L20 42 Z" fill="#C8692A"/>

  <!-- lid plank lines -->
  <path d="M22 32 Q50 24 78 32" stroke="#8B4513" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none"/>
  <path d="M20 40 Q50 34 80 40" stroke="#8B4513" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none"/>

  <!-- lid metal bands -->
  <path d="M16 46 L16 38 Q16 22 24 22 L24 46 Z" fill="#DAA520"/>
  <path d="M76 46 L76 38 Q76 22 84 22 L84 46 Z" fill="#DAA520"/>
  <path d="M47 22 Q47 30 47 46 L53 46 L53 22 Q50 21 47 22 Z" fill="#DAA520"/>
  <!-- lid band highlights -->
  <path d="M18 40 L18 24 L22 24 L22 40 Z" fill="#FFD700"/>
  <path d="M78 40 L78 24 L82 24 L82 40 Z" fill="#FFD700"/>
  <path d="M48 25 L48 44 L52 44 L52 25 Z" fill="#FFD700"/>

  <!-- lid top hinge bumps -->
  <circle cx="28" cy="24" r="2.5" fill="#FFD700"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="22" r="2.5" fill="#FFD700"/>
  <circle cx="72" cy="24" r="2.5" fill="#FFD700"/>

  <!-- treasure glow spilling from lid -->
  <path d="M22 44 Q35 38 50 40 Q65 38 78 44 L78 46 L22 46 Z" fill="#FFE44D" opacity="0.7"/>

  <!-- coins peeking out -->
  <ellipse cx="34" cy="44" rx="4" ry="2" fill="#FFD700"/>
  <ellipse cx="40" cy="42" rx="3.5" ry="2" fill="#FFE44D"/>
  <ellipse cx="60" cy="43" rx="4" ry="2" fill="#FFD700"/>
  <ellipse cx="65" cy="44" rx="3" ry="1.5" fill="#FFE44D"/>

  <!-- gem peeking -->
  <polygon points="52,40 55,36 58,40 55,43" fill="#00CED1"/>
  <polygon points="52,40 55,36 55,43" fill="#40E0D0"/>

  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill="#FFFF80">
    <polygon points="30,18 31,21 34,22 31,23 30,26 29,23 26,22 29,21"/>
    <polygon points="70,16 71,19 74,20 71,21 70,24 69,21 66,20 69,19"/>
    <polygon points="50,14 50.8,16.5 53,17 50.8,17.8 50,20 49.2,17.8 47,17 49.2,16.5"/>
  </g>

  <!-- feet -->
  <rect x="22" y="82" width="10" height="6" rx="2" fill="#DAA520"/>
  <rect x="68" y="82" width="10" height="6" rx="2" fill="#DAA520"/>
</svg>
